sentences.text:
------
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY ------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Sameer Sahay, Advocate For the State : Mrs. Priya Shrestha, Spl. P.P.
------
Order No.06 Dated- 07.02.2025 Heard the parties.

Apprehending his arrest, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Kamdara P.S. Case No.51 of 2022 registered under sections 409/ 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

The Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner in furtherance of common intention with the co-accused persons committed criminal breach of trust in respect of government property by taking the money from the government without doing any work.
It is further submitted that the allegations against the petitioner are all false and the petitioner is not named in the FIR and the main allegation is against the co-accused persons.
It is next submitted that the petitioner is only the supplier of paint and materials related to paint and he has got nothing to do with the construction of the concerned work.
It is then submitted that the petitioner undertakes to furnish sufficient security including cash security and also undertakes to cooperate with the investigation of the case.
It is lastly submitted that the co-accused person has already been given the privilege of anticipatory bail by a coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 05.03.2024 in A.B.A. No.636 of 2023.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioner be also given the privilege of anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Learned Spl. P.P. opposes the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail.
Considering the submissions of the counsels and the fact as discussed above, I am of the opinion that it is a fit case where the abovenamed petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Hence, in the event of his arrest or surrender within a period of six weeks from the date of this order, he shall be released on bail on depositing cash security of Rs. 25,000/- and on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned A.C.J.M., Gumla, in connection with Kamdara P.S. Case No.51 of 2022 with the condition that the petitioner will cooperate with the investigation of the case and appear before the Investigating Officer as and when noticed by him and will furnish his mobile number and a copy of his Aadhar Card in the court below with the undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case subject to the conditions laid down under Section 482 (2)
of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
(Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.) Sonu/Gunjan- Satish Ram vs The State Of Jharkhand ... Opposite ... on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175311314/
